title: Reward Modeling for Mitigating Toxicity in Transformer-Based Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model toxicity (Expected Maximum Toxicity and Toxicity Probability) and perplexity on 20-token continuations generated from gender-specific prompts in the BOLD dataset.

Measuring the Expected Maximum Toxicity, Toxicity Probability, and model perplexity of text continuations conditioned on BOLD dataset prompts mentioning specific racial and ethnic groups (e.g., African Americans, Asian Americans).
Assessing toxicity metrics and perplexity of language model outputs when prompted with text from the BOLD dataset conditioned on various religious belief identifiers.

Incorporating sexual orientation identity attributes (e.g., heterosexual, homosexual-gay-or-lesbian) into a multitask learning reward model using the Jigsaw dataset to mitigate unintended bias during reinforcement learning fine-tuning.
